name: camera_fpc15
title: Camera connector
purpose: 15-pin 1 mm FPC socket for the Raspberry Pi Global Shutter Camera (MIPI CSI-2, I2C, power enable, 3.3 V)

sources.title: Raspberry Pi documentation, Camera connector pinout (15-pin)
sources.read: Camera connector pinout (15-pin) table and notes

sources.title: Raspberry Pi standard camera cable 200 mm reference drawing RP-008146-DS-1
sources.licence: Raspberry Pi document; link and quotes only

parts.quote: rpicam: "The connector is compatible with Amphenol SFW15R-2STE1LF"; pins "1 GND", "2 CAM_DN0", "3 CAM_DP0", "4 GND", "5 CAM_DN1", "6 CAM_DP1", "7 GND", "8 CAM_CN", "9 CAM_CP", "10 GND", "11 CAM_IO0", "12 CAM_IO1", "13 SCL", "14 SDA", "15 3V3"; "Typically, CAM_IO0 is used as an active-high power enable"; "The I2C lines (SCL and SDA) are pulled up to 3.3 V on the Raspberry Pi board". cable: "Pins 15", "Pitch P 1.000 mm", "Width W 16.000 mm". KiCad has no SFW15R footprint: TE 1-84952-5 (KiCad: "15 bottom-side contacts, 1.0mm pitch, 1.0mm height") instead

/CSI_D0_P.note: D-PHY; lane 1 unused by the IMX296 (one lane) but wired

/CSI_D0_N.note: D-PHY; lane 1 unused by the IMX296 (one lane) but wired

/CSI_D1_P.note: D-PHY; lane 1 unused by the IMX296 (one lane) but wired

/CSI_D1_N.note: D-PHY; lane 1 unused by the IMX296 (one lane) but wired

/CSI_CLK_P.note: D-PHY; lane 1 unused by the IMX296 (one lane) but wired

/CSI_CLK_N.note: D-PHY; lane 1 unused by the IMX296 (one lane) but wired

/CAM_EN.note: CAM_IO0, the camera's power enable (active high)

layout.rules: the socket on the board edge, the cable leaving the board; CSI pairs routed as differential pairs (DIFF net class)

open_questions: Contact side: the Pi's socket (SFW15R-2STE1LF) drawing was not read; the bottom-contact TE socket assumes the cable's contacts face the board at this end.
CAM_IO1 (pin 12) left open: the GS camera's use of it is not documented.
No ESD or common-mode filters on the CSI lines (the Nucleo fits ECMF2-40A100N6 on its camera connector): the cable stays inside the tracker.
